title: Match a quadratic branch to a constant
statement:
For $f(x)=x^2+1$ when $x<[$a]$ and $f(x)=k$ when $x\ge[$a]$, find $k$ making $f$ continuous.

[__________]{a}
hints: Evaluate its limit at the join.
Match that value to the assigned right-branch value.
solution: The left limit is $[$a]^2+1$ and the right limit and function value are $k$, so $k=[$a]^2+1$.

feedback.message: Match that value to the assigned right-branch value.
